sections.value: Closure update to the earlier State notice is not sender authority and C32 audit is an acceptance condition notes: #149 at5963c27c9957bfd97cdaf84092493a44dd6fdbb1 now PASS-WITH-NOTES. S003 closes because every notice has neutral pij-bg sender, while the original actor, binding, reason, recipient and message ID are persisted with the atomic close/audit. An owed retry merely replays that immutable audited intent; the retrier cannot become sender or alter provenance. Do not demand another closure audit for pure recovery, and do not confuse failed post-commit visibility with missing durable audit. This adds no stronger cryptographic-origin requirement beyond C32. Earlier e0004f8/697b6aa blocks are historical, not current closure findings. Migration40 followsmain39; competing#156 must renumber if it merges second. Source/CI review only, no local tests or probes. Current queue/results and rules are in outputs/handover-pij-bumpy-herring-2026-11-08.md; resume from that file, not stale packets.
